bio.text: Riley Moore represents West Virginia's 2nd District in the U.S. House of Representatives and sits on the House Appropriations Committee.
He previously served in the West Virginia House of Delegates and as the 25th West Virginia State Treasurer.
He began his career as a welder in a mining operation and earned degrees from George Mason University and the National Defense University.
A native of Morgantown, he lives in Harpers Ferry.
